PROVISIONAL: D7: every figure marked provisional in `sources` is a stand-in until the owner tests it in game; tunable here. Only the numbers are consumed (utility.FIGURES); editing a source or a note changes nothing.

sources.reveal_range_m: Provisional. How far Fade's Haunt and Sova's Recon Bolt see from where they are; no figure found. In-game test: throw each at a known spot and walk a teammate out along a straight line until they stop being revealed.
sources.skye_flash_range_m: Provisional. How far from its detonation Skye's Guiding Light flashes someone looking at it; no figure found. In-game test: pop it in a long corridor with a teammate at increasing distances, facing it.
sources.leer_cast_range_m: Sourced: Leer's deployment distance is 10 m (can shorten against terrain), https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Leer (game-file sourced) and https://www.thespike.gg/valorant/agents/reyna. Its terrain/height behaviour is untested.
sources.knife_rim_m: Approved by the owner (AFK D1, 2026-10-16). The margin KAY/O's ZERO/point knife gives its radius in all four cases (knife_zero, knife_all, knife_hit, knife_missed): an enemy held inside it (all hit, or hit by a partial pulse) is held within r + this; one ruled out (none hit, or missed by a partial pulse) is ruled out only within max(0, r - this). Measured on 45 local knives: 7 of 202 living enemies stood within 0.88-1.01 r, all on the right side of the edge at +-0.3 s; run speed 6.75 m/s x 0.3 s is about 2 m. 0 restores the plain radius.
sources.drone: PROVISIONAL (util-info-value W3, D13). Flown drones' vision cone (`half_deg`, either side of the heading) and range. Thrash: max vision radius 20 m, https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Thrash; the wiki gives no cone, so 45 degrees is ASSUMED (the dog's). Tejo's Stealth Drone: vision radius 18 m, cone 60 degrees either side, https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Stealth_Drone.
sources.creature: PROVISIONAL (W3, D13). Creatures' sight cones, read by later items. Prowler: detection range 15 m (agent), https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Prowler, no cone angle on the wiki: 45 degrees ASSUMED. Boom Bot: max detection cone distance 15 m, https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Boom_Bot, 'large frontal cone' with no angle: 45 degrees ASSUMED. Wingman: max detection cone distance 15 m and cone angle 90 degrees either side, https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Wingman (the angle row is commented out in the page source: the page notes bots have been seen detecting at larger angles). Seekers: the wiki gives neither a detection cone nor a range, so the dog's 45 degrees and 22.5 m are ASSUMED.
sources.hunters_fury: PROVISIONAL (W3, D13). Sova's Hunter's Fury blast: 66 m length, 1.76 m radius (a strip 3.52 m wide), pierces terrain, https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Hunter%27s_Fury.
sources.nightfall: PROVISIONAL (W3, D13). Fade's Nightfall wave: 40 m length, 20 m width (nerfed from 24 m), https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Nightfall.
sources.dizzy_range_m: PROVISIONAL (W3, D13). Gekko's Dizzy fires at enemies in line of sight within 45 m, https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Dizzy (its 2.5 m plasma radius is not used here).
sources.thrash_detain_radius_m: PROVISIONAL (W3, D13). Thrash's lunge radius 5 m (the detain explosion), https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Thrash.

sources.fakeout: PROVISIONAL (W3, D13). Yoru's Fakeout flash wedge: 30 degrees either side of the direction the image looks, https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Fakeout (the row is commented out in the page source). The wiki gives no flash range, so the dog's 22.5 m is ASSUMED.
sources.hearing_m: Provisional: each is the footstep range (hearing.json footstep_range_m, itself the owner's to check), set on purpose until measured, never a silent fallback. In-game tests: from From the Shadows' destination, Gatecrash's beacon, Dimensional Drift's exit and Refract's recall, walk a teammate away until the sound stops; note the distance.
sources.molly: Sourced (decision D6, changed 2026-10-09: the owner pointed to https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Deterrent; the figures are on each ability's own page there). How long each damaging molly burns from its landing (`seconds`, capped at its row's end, the actor close) and its radius (`radius_m`). Hot Hands (wiki/Hot_Hands): 4.5 m, 4 s (0.75 s spread, 3.25 s at full size). Incendiary (wiki/Incendiary): 4.5 m, 8 s total (0.25 s explosion, 0.75 s spread, 7 s at full size). Snake Bite (wiki/Snake_Bite): 4.5 m, 6.5 s. Nanoswarm (wiki/Nanoswarm): 4.5 m, 4 s; its row is the damage actor, which starts at activation, not at the throw. Mosh Pit (wiki/Mosh_Pit): inner radius 5.5 m (full damage; the outer ring to 6.2 m does half), a 3 s windup then 3 explosion ticks 0.1 s apart, so 3.3 s; the inner radius is used, the smaller of the two. The wiki gives no wall or ledge behaviour beyond 'most molotovs expand up to any walls and ledges', which the footprint already follows. Added in the same review (the owner's list of everything that stops the unknown; held from when it shows on the ground until its last damage): Aftershock (wiki/Aftershock): a cylinder of 3 m radius and 10 m length, through the wall, blasts 2.2 and 2.8 s after it sticks, so 3 s. Orbital Strike (wiki/Orbital_Strike): 9 m, a 2 s windup, 3 s at full size and a 0.75 s fadeaway, so 5.75 s. Guided Salvo (wiki/Guided_Salvo): outer radius 4.5 m (inner 2.5), from the missile hitting the ground (its `AirStrikeMortar` row; 1.25 s windup, 3 detonations 0.8 s apart), so 2.9 s. Armageddon (wiki/Armageddon): each recorded segment a strip 2 m along the path and 12 m across (`radius_m` 6 is half the width, unused by the strip's shape), held from the cast until 1 s after the segment goes off (4 ticks 0.25 s apart). FRAG/ment (wiki/FRAG-ment): outer radius 4 m (inner 1), a 0.5 s windup then 4 ticks 1 s apart, so 4 s from its landing. Vyse's Razorvine (wiki/Razorvine: 6.25 m, 6 s) has no entry: no replay has shown its object yet. The owner checked the scale with valoplant (2026-10-09; Armageddon's 12 x 32 m as the ruler): it agrees within 0.2 m except Snake Bite (3.7 m drawn), Nanoswarm (4.0), Hot Hands (4.2), Orbital Strike (8.0) and Razorvine (5.0); the owner chose the wiki's game-file figures. Which zones count, their shapes and which pass walls are decided in code (app/control/mollies.py), not here.
